REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 11, 2024 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar, Closed Session, and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 6.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.us in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

 2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer.

 3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Councilmember Frank Aurelio Yokoyama.

 4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce W. Barrows was noted absent for the record.

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Frank Aurelio Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Vo, to excuse Council/Agency
  Member Bruce W. Barrows from the Thursday, July 11, 2024, 7:00 p.m. City
  Council/Successor Agency regular meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  AYES:  Johnson, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Barrows

 5.  Presentations/Appointments

 5A.  Presentations

  None.

 At this juncture of the meeting, Mayor Solanki announced a brief update on Item 8A would be
 provided by Bill Ihrke, City Attorney.

 with City staff. The City received correspondence which raised the legal ability to address the
 proposed ordinance amendment and fees therein. He stated additional time to review the
 matter is required by the City Attorney and City staff; Item 8A would not be presented and
 considered during this meeting, however, members of the public who wish to comment may do
 so during general public comments (Item 6).

 With no objection, Item 8A was removed from the agenda.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Vanessa Ejike, Summer Intern, Assemblymember Sharon Quirk-Silva, announced
  several of the Assemblymember’s upcoming events.

  Joe Pak, Field Representative, Assemblymember Sharon Quirk-Silva, announced several
  of the Assemblymember’s upcoming events.

  Al Barlevy requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire in
  Palestine. He submitted a document for the official record entitled “A Resolution of the
  City Council of the City of Huntington Park supporting the resumption of a negotiated
  bilateral ceasefire in Gaza and reiterating its condemnation of all anti-semitism, anti-
  Arab racism, Islamophobia, and all forms of hate and incitement of violence.”
  (Documents submitted to the City Council at a public meeting are considered public
  record. Public requests for copies of the full-text, redacted written correspondence can
  be made during regular business hours to the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer).

  Maha Afra requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire in
  Palestine.

  Maragaret Villa requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire in
  Palestine.

  Emmanuel Ronquillo requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire
  in Palestine.

  Michael Diaz requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire in
  Palestine.

  Sam Desai thanked the City Council for the additional pickleball courts placed at Liberty
  Park. He expressed concern regarding the nearby sprinkler system overwatering the
  area and suggested a fence around the courts. He also requested a Wildlife Impact
  Safety program and requested the City Council remove Item 7E regarding Heritage Park
  Play Island renovation, from the Consent Calendar, for separate consideration.

  Krisha Vallejos requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire in
  Palestine.

  Unidentified speaker requested the City Council adopt a resolution calling for a ceasefire
  in Palestine.

  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Treasurer, announced that prior to the meeting, the
  Council/Agency members received full-text, unredacted copies of the one (1) written
  comment submitted for meeting items by the deadline listed on the agenda and for
  inclusion in the official record. Requests for copies of the written comments submitted
  for this meeting can be made during regular business hours to the Office of the City
  Clerk/Treasurer.

  Seeing no further speakers, the Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

  Written comments, if submitted by the deadline listed on the agenda, are considered
  part of the meeting record and are available upon request in the Office of the City
  Clerk/Treasurer during regular business hours.
